source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Duet Sport Front-Load Washer (Job Aid L-78)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: WARNING — Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Pressure hose and tub connection OK
steps.body: Verify the pressure switch hose is connected to the tub, air trap is clear, and hose is not kinked, pinched, or leaking. F20 if pressure switch does not trip within 6 minutes of fill.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify the pressure switch hose is connected to the tub, air trap is clear, and hose is not kinked, pinched, or leaking. F20 if pressure switch does not trip within 6 minutes of fill.

branches.label: Hose/trap issue
branches.oemOutcome: Clear air trap, repair hose routing, replace leaking hose; retest fill.

steps.title: Disconnect pressure switch hose
steps.body: Refer to job aid §4-7. Disconnect wire connector and hose from the pressure switch.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Refer to job aid §4-7. Disconnect wire connector and hose from the pressure switch.

steps.title: Blow hose — contacts close at each level
steps.body: Set ohmmeter to R×1. Touch leads to pressure switch pins per OEM chart while blowing into the hose inlet to activate the diaphragm. Each level should read 0 Ω while activated: Empty pins 4&6; Suds Detect pins 1&2; L1 pins 4&5; Overflow pins 3&4.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Blow into hose inlet to activate diaphragm — 0 Ω for each measurement while activated.

branches.label: All levels close (0 Ω) when activated
Level contact fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace pressure switch when level contacts fail to close.

steps.title: Disconnect PR6 at CCU
steps.body: Disconnect pressure switch connector PR6 from the CCU.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect pressure switch connector PR6 from the CCU.

steps.title: PR6 pins 1 & 2 — suds detect (0 Ω)
steps.body: With ohmmeter on PR6 pins 1 and 2, does the suds-detect level read 0 Ω when the pressure switch diaphragm is activated (blow into hose or simulate suds level)?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Connector PR6 pins 1 and 2 should indicate 0 Ω.

branches.label: Does not close
branches.oemOutcome: Replace pressure switch — PR6 suds level not tripping (F20).

steps.title: Service hose and trap
steps.oemOutcome: Clear pressure hose and air trap; retest fill.

steps.title: Pressure switch verified
steps.oemOutcome: Hose path and PR6 level contacts OK — investigate inlet valves if F20 persists.
